CustomField.description: Automatically calculates the next governance review date based on the last completed review date, or the agent creation date if no review has been completed yet.
CustomField.formula: IF( NOT(ISBLANK(LastReviewDate__c)), ADDMONTHS( LastReviewDate__c, ReviewFrequencyMonths__c ), IF( NOT(ISBLANK(AgentCreationDate__c)), ADDMONTHS( AgentCreationDate__c, ReviewFrequencyMonths__c ), NULL ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Automatically calculates the next governance review date based on the last completed review date, or the agent creation date if no review has been completed yet.
CustomField.label: Next Review Date
